@@U03770@@
I’m astonished, and should like to ask many questions. Tell me why that good man’s speech sounds so strange, strange but also pleasing. One sound seems to fit so well with the next, and no sooner is one word settled in the ear than along comes another to caress it.

@@U03772@@
It’s the way we speak. But how much more our music will delight you. Tt will move you to the very depths of your soul. There’s nothing better than practice to teach you how. Shall we begin?

@@U03774@@
Tell me, then, how I can speak so charmingly.

@@U03776@@
That’s easily done. You must simply speak from the heart. And when the soul is touched with passion’s flame, we look around and ask—

@@U03778@@
—who burns the same?

@@U03780@@
Neither past nor future has power to bless; the present moment—

@@U03782@@
—is our happiness.

@@U03784@@
It’s treasure, wondrous gain, supreme command. What gives it confirmation?’
translation:
@@U03770@@
我很惊讶，想问很多问题。告诉我为什么那个好人的讲话听起来那么奇怪，奇怪但又令人愉悦。一个声音似乎与下一个声音非常契合，一个词刚一落入耳中，另一个词就会轻抚它。

@@U03772@@
这就是我们说话的方式。但我们的音乐会让您更加高兴。它会感动你到你灵魂的最深处。没有什么比练习更能教你如何做到这一点了。我们开始吧？

@@U03774@@
Tell me, then, how I can speak so charmingly.

@@U03776@@
这很容易做到。你必须只是发自内心地说话。当灵魂被激情的火焰触动时，我们环顾四周并问——

@@U03778@@
——谁会燃烧同样的东西？

@@U03780@@
过去和未来都没有力量祝福；当下——

@@U03782@@
——是我们的幸福。

@@U03784@@
是宝物，是奇妙的收获，是至高无上的命令。是什么证实了这一点？
